item.title: Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
item.description: OpenAI Academy is bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to caregivers in five U.S. cities, helping them build practical AI skills for everyday life.

item.title: Closing the AI guidance gap in education
item.description: New ThinkYoung research and lessons from OpenAI’s EMEA education partnerships on supporting teachers, AI literacy, and independent learning.

item.title: Work at the Frontier: AI’s effect on freelance work
item.description: New research from OpenAI and Upwork finds shifting demand for freelance work, new skill combinations, and larger budgets and more hours for AI-related projects.

item.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
item.description: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace, helping organizations simplify procurement through existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships.

item.title: Evernote turns AI-driven discovery into paid subscriptions
item.description: Evernote used ChatGPT Ads to introduce its note-taking app to people working with AI. The team tracked how often free trials led to paid subscriptions.

item.title: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand partnership across enterprise workflows
item.description: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand their partnership to bring OpenAI models and agents into ServiceNow and ServiceNow workflows into ChatGPT and Codex.

item.title: Introducing LifeSciBench
item.description: Introducing LifeSciBench, an expert-authored, expert-reviewed benchmark for evaluating how AI systems handle real-world life science research tasks and decisions.

item.title: Predicting model behavior before release by simulating deployment
item.description: OpenAI introduces Deployment Simulation, a method to predict AI model behavior before deployment using real conversation data to improve safety and evaluation accuracy.
